notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis and Spark Double's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spark Double.
Spark Double's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat.
